svg.title: High freshness retains the cubic and quartic atoms on their own footprints with coefficient −(α+∆). Arity-r paid bills are startup coefficients times tr; 0 < t ≤1 permits a common t3 bound for r = 3, 4. Each slot is first order along exponential link lines, so division of an arity-r atom by the line parameter to power r has finite limit. Division by its square instead tends to zero. Taylor expansion at the critical identity and polarization give zero diagonal and mixed Hessians in all directions, retaining the existing masks and adding no boundary term. The lift retains ordered pair indices, common selectors, symbol normalization and the orientation-normalized layer. Recovery preserves absolute double sums and finite reindexing, so both kinetic and proxy identities, and the high-term Hessian vanishing, recover with these exact normalizations.
